source.check: returned unopposed: named in column 6 ('Names of Candidates Elected') with no votes in column 5, where no poll was taken, in the Returning Officer's notice of result dated 5 June 1958 (Ulster Star, 7 June 1958, p. 9; read on the BNA page image)

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polling day Thursday 5 June 1958. There was no poll: the Returning Officer's notice of result dated 5 June 1958 (Ulster Star, 7 June 1958, p. 9) names one member elected for each of the sixteen divisions, none with votes recorded. The Belfast News-Letter (21 May 1958, p. 11) had reported fifteen nominations for fifteen seats; the official notice lists sixteen (meetings pass, 7 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Renamed from 'Ballyworphy' to Ballyworfy (19 Nov 2026, w19-tidy, the owner's decision 4 of 19 Nov 2026: a division filed under two spellings takes its official name, and each round keeps the spelling it was filed under as Constituency_Name_As_Printed): the 1911 DED map (Hillsborough Rural District) and the Northern Ireland DED maps of 1921-69 name the DED Ballyworfy; the rounds were filed as Ballyworfy (1924, 1930, 1933, 1949, 1952, 1955, 1967); Ballyworphy (1927, 1936, 1939, 1946, 1958, 1961, 1964). This round was filed as 'Ballyworphy', kept as Constituency_Name_As_Printed; the old address (ballyworphy) answers with a redirect to this one.
